org.portico.lrc.services.object.data

Class ICInterest

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.portico.lrc.services.object.data.ICInterest
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Serializable

    public class ICInterest
extends Object
implements Serializable
    This class represents a particular publication or subscription interest a particular federate has in an interaction class. It contains the handle of the federate in question, as well as the ICMetadata instance representing the interaction class. It also has an optional set of RegionInstances that represent the regions that the federate has associated with the interest (**only applies if the interest is a subscription).

    Instances of this class are used by the InterestManager.

    NOTE that DDM information only applies to subscription interests. It is not used for publication interests and can be safely ignored if it is representing a publication.

    See Also:

      • getInteractionClass

        public ICMetadata getInteractionClass()

      • registerInterest

        public void registerInterest(int federateHandle)

      • registerInterest

        public void registerInterest(int federateHandle,
                             RegionInstance region)
        Register the federate as having an interest in the interaction class with the given region. If the federate already has an interest in the class, this will just augment that interest with the new region.

        NOTE: If the given RegionInstance is null, this is just the same as calling registerInterest(int). This is the signal to ignore DDM concerns.

      • hasInterest

        public boolean hasInterest(int federateHandle)
        Returns true if the given federate has an interest in the interaction class associated with this interest (false otherwise).

      • removeInterest

        public void removeInterest(int federateHandle)
        Removes the interest of the federate in the interaction class TOTALLY. If there is any region data associated with the interest, all that will also be removed.

      • removeInterest

        public void removeInterest(int federateHandle,
                           RegionInstance region)
        This method will remove the given region from those associated with the interest the federate has in the interaction class. If that region is the last one associated with the interest, then the interest will itself be removed as well. If there is no existing region data associated with the interests, the entire interest will be removed (it will act the same was as removeInterest(int).

        NOTE: If the given RegionInstance is null, this is just the same as calling registerInterest(int). This is the signal to ignore DDM concerns.

      • getFederates

        public Set<Integer> getFederates()
        Get the full set of federates that have an interest in the associated interaction class. This set is an unmodifiable version of the underlying collection.

      • getRegions

        public Set<RegionInstance> getRegions(int federateHandle)
        Get all the regions associated with the interests this federate has in the interaction class. If there are none, an empty set will be returned. If there are some, an unmodifiable version of the underlying collection will be returned.
